latest.title: Even if Clarity fails, Wall Street’s crypto push is unlikely to stop
latest.description: The Clarity Act could give banks, brokers and asset managers a clearer rulebook, but financial firms have already moved far enough into digital assets that failure may slow adoption rather than stop it.
